mapping.assembly: GRCh38 as existing locked query contract
mapping.coordinate_row_rule: Validate every source row as corrective read_coordinates does, and retain first encountered exact symbol only; no alternate isoform aggregation or remapping.
mapping.coordinate_base: Source TSV values used unchanged; no coordinate +1/-1 conversion.
mapping.gene_body: start/end are the pinned genomic bounds; promoter extends upstream of strand-specific TSS and interval terminates at TES/gene-body bound.
mapping.peak_point: floor((peak_start+peak_end)/2) using bigBed half-open peak coordinates, not summit/signal/full-interval overlap
mapping.hit: chromosome equal AND interval_start <= peak_midpoint < interval_end
mapping.multi_gene_hits: Any gene locus containing the midpoint is supported; do not choose nearest gene or a single winning gene.
mapping.chromosome_alias_policy: Exact chromosomes as stored, no alias/liftover; any missing target coordinates or incompatible chromosome assembly stops label construction.
mapping.peak_parsing: Installed pyBigWig local bigBed only; handle.entries on panel chromosomes; validate 0 <= start < end <= chromosome length, and count all peak rows. No peak-height threshold or new preprocessing.
mapping.distinct_support_rule: Per-experiment target set; union within an experiment before intersecting the two experiment sets. Multiple files or replicates inside one ENCSR never count as two experiments.
mapping.label_rule: positive iff target is supported in both ENCSR715FHW and ENCSR841XDW. Every other frozen nonself target is strictly unlabeled, including one-experiment hits and zero hits. CTCF self target excluded before class counts.
mapping.old_audit_reuse_prohibited: Prior blue_evidence_external_local counts/symbols used old446TFpanel and an inclusive endpoint; use only its file metadata, never its labels/867-positive count.

training_exposure.geneformer_embed: Actual GeneformerV2-104M bound weight; official genecorpus104M row319 lists source DOI10.1038/s41588-021-00894-z and61770braincells. Source inclusion confirmed; exact evaluated-cell/person membership unresolved.
training_exposure.geneformer_attention: Same actual GeneformerV2 source exposure; readout differs, not training provenance.
training_exposure.random_init_geneformer: Random initialization is a no-pretrained-weights contrast, but architecture/tokens/medians/panel use shared externally derived resources; not a wholly independent or never-exposed pipeline.
training_exposure.scfoundation_encoder: Published2024BioMapinventory contains all19GSE174367RNA GSM (rows8622–8640,45508reservedcells). Actual localcell weight binds third-party mirror; originalBioMap-to-mirror/version bridge remains unresolved. Exact evaluated-cell membership unknown.
training_exposure.scgpt_encoder: Actual officialwholehumancheckpoint identity known; publicationCensus2023-05-15 source/filter/UUID-to-weight ledger incomplete. Brain-cell membership unknown, not excluded by accession absence.
training_exposure.uce_encoder: Actual official4layercheckpoint identity known; published33layer2026inventory not automatically applicable. Exact4layerbrain-source/cell exposure unknown.
training_exposure.external_assay_training_overlap: No checkpoint-bound record verifies exclusion of these occupancy experiments or any shared upstream biological priors. Assay measurement is separate; that does not make corrected RNA never-pretrained.

audit_flag_policy.use_only_exploratory: Both selected experiments share partially characterized antibody NOT_COMPLIANT, missing controlled_by WARNING and mismatched status INTERNAL_ACTION; released/IDR criterion does not certify biological accuracy. File flags preserved separately.

biological_scope.sampling_unit: One fixed CTCF target-universe sensitivity, not multiple independent TFs, donors or experiments as statistical replicates.
biological_scope.tissue_context: Locked biosample summaries describe Alzheimer DLPFC tissue; corrected RNA is GSE174367 frontal-cortex nuclei. Broad brain/frontal context only, not exact region, donor, age/condition mixture or cell-type matching.
biological_scope.person_mapping: 18correctiveSampleIDs have36verifiedRNA/ATACGSMassignments and0verifiedunique-person crosswalks; independent donor count remains unknown. The two ENCSR IDs are distinct experiment identifiers, not proof of distinct people.
biological_scope.reference_scope: CTCF protein-DNA occupancy near gene locus; no verified directed transcriptional effect, otherTF truth, enhancer links, or biological gate labels.
biological_scope.selection_limit: Brain panel preselected before corrective model outcomes but uses same RNA pool as graph/coexpression, overlaps460historicalgenes and is not an independent expression holdout. No occupancy-based panel filtering allowed.

finite_policy.primary_external_universe: All1199 frozen CTCF->nonself-target pairs, before scores. No arbitrary all-model gene intersection.
finite_policy.paired_mask: For each readout, finite(stored CTCF row) AND finite(stored coexpression CTCF row), on the same frozen1199targets. Compute only mask/counts in preflight.
finite_policy.external_gate: Require gene_coverage_fraction>=0.90 AND all1199model and baseline CTCF target scores finite, with saved receipt identities verified. A reduced finite intersection never becomes an eligible rerun.
finite_policy.exclusion: Any absent graph/receipt, changed source context/panel identity, CTCF absent/unobserved, nonfinite CTCF-target model/baseline pair, insufficient class count, or gene coverage<.90 keeps the readout excluded and all its metrics null. Keep count/reason/targetmask digest; do not fill zeros or drop slots.
finite_policy.primary_vs_external: Global442x1199primary coverage flags remain disclosed. This external sensitivity evaluates a separately fixed CTCF row; it does not override primary exclusions. A global-primary-excluded readout may only have an external measurement if its entire prespecified1199CTCFtarget set and baseline are finite.
finite_policy.baseline: Readout baseline uses the identical target IDs, external labels and finite-pair mask; report paired baseline AUC/AP and differences. No best-baseline or best-sign selection.
finite_policy.excluded_model_baseline: For an excluded slot, paired baseline/delta also null; do not show a favourable baseline on a different finite subset.
finite_policy.cross_readout_model_ranking: Forbidden; six rows are readout-specific sensitivities, not a model ranking.

metric_specification.AUC: Descriptive ROC area treating experimentally supported positives as1 and unlabeled targets as0 solely for metric computation. Equivalent positive-unlabeled rank concordance; equal-score ties contribute0.5. Not sensitivity/specificity against true negatives.
metric_specification.AP: Noninterpolated average precision using descending stored score and grouped score ties (sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score convention); unlabeled0 is bookkeeping, not a verified negative.
metric_specification.score_orientation: Larger frozen stored graph entry considered higher association. Existing absolute-cosine graph and directional attention definitions retained; no abs/sign switch using occupancy outcomes.
metric_specification.CTCF_row_direction: TF/source row to target column, graph[CTCF_gene_index,j]; do not average with transpose or select whichever direction scores better.
metric_specification.paired_delta_AUC: model_AUC - paired_coexpression_AUC on the exact same target set
metric_specification.paired_delta_AP: model_AP - paired_coexpression_AP on the exact same target set
metric_specification.AP_prevalence_context: Report positive count/unlabeled count and positive fraction alongside AP; positive fraction is operational label prevalence only.
reporting: exact assay experiment/file identifiers and audit flags
positive and unlabeled labels explicitly named
forbidden: p-values/null permutations/FDR or inferential model ranks
biological validity or necessity of historical five-gate endpoint
retroactive repair of historical family or fivePBMCrows

scope: One CTCF positive-unlabeled occupancy sensitivity; no negatives, CI, p-values, model ranking or causal/gate validation.
